name: ux-research
description: 'Research ClipYantra users, creator workflows, personas, jobs-to-be-done and product usability hypotheses before designing screens.'
agent: product-designer
---

Use `product-ux-research`. Read-only repository inspection plus documentation proposal only if authorized.

Review the PRD and discovery findings. Validate or revise the hypothesized personas: podcasters/interview creators, educators/technical creators, gamers/streamers, entertainment creators and content operators.

Deliver `docs/design/01-UX-RESEARCH.md` with facts vs assumptions, jobs-to-be-done, end-to-end journey, pain points, questions requiring user input, success measures and research plan. Do not invent interviews, quotes, metrics or validated findings. No frontend code. End with `NEEDS APPROVAL` and request `APPROVE UX v1` or specific changes.
